description: Selected aggregate results from Brandon Santor's completed local research and engineering checks. No event coordinates or contributor datasets are included.

precision_experiment.scope: Maximum adjusted probability margin among 32 fixed metrics. Simulation precision under specified assumptions, not real-world location accuracy or biological validation.

gis_rebuild.scope: Completed local rebuild and portability checks. Independent recipient reproduction is a separate step. Layer count is not a count of scientific findings.

source_reconciliation.scope: Completed source-reconciliation checks, preserving source differences and unresolved conflicts. These checks do not establish field accuracy.
